_about: Shadow models (docs/shadow-records.md): each publishes its own genuine pre-match records beside the models of record, by the same code and rules, so every model builds a live track record. A shadow record is never the record of record: `footy publish-shadows` refuses any model that primary_models.json lists from now on. Roles: machine_learning, challenger, baseline, earlier_record. `decision` (optional) names the DECISIONS.md entry the record's notes cite; the role's default otherwise.

domestic.description: Machine learning with prices: a mix of the shots, Elo-with-context and GLM-booster forecasts, each moved onto the bookmakers' prices, whose weights relearn after every result.
Machine learning with prices: learns how to correct the shots model moved onto the prices from what the Elo-with-context and GLM-booster forecasts say, retrained at every run.
Machine learning without prices: a mix of the shots, Elo-with-context, Dixon-Coles and GLM-booster forecasts whose weights relearn after every result.
Machine learning without prices: learns how to correct the Elo-with-context forecast from what the shots model and the GLM booster say, retrained at every run.
Shots model: team strengths from shots and shots on target as well as goals; the model of record before the prices are applied.
Goal-based Elo: team ratings that move with each result's goal difference; the base of the fallback of record.
Ensemble: the result from one blend of four lab models and the exact scores from another, with weights fitted on 2022/23.
Dynamic ratings: team strengths updated after every match by two Kalman-filter ratings (shots and goals) and pi-ratings, blended 60/20/20.
Score-shape model: the shots model's expected goals with a different score distribution (a goal-by-goal birth process) in place of Poisson.
Tuned Dixon-Coles with each league's scoring level recalibrated on recent matches.
Gradient boosting: a goals model on engineered team features (form, shots, Elo, rest) with boosted trees on top, mixed 75/25 with Dixon-Coles.
Tuned Dixon-Coles: separate time decay for team strengths and league terms, and a both-teams-to-score adjustment.
Model + market: the Elo-with-context grid moved onto the bookmakers' prices; it won validation but not the test (D-027).
Model + market: the Dixon-Coles grid moved onto the bookmakers' prices.
Model + market: the goal-based Elo grid moved onto the bookmakers' prices.
Model + market: the split ensemble's grid moved onto the bookmakers' prices.
Baseline: independent Poisson goals from each team's attack and defence, every past match weighted equally.
Baseline: each league's home, draw and away, goal-line and both-teams-to-score rates over the last two years; the same forecast for every match in a league.

uefa.description: The UEFA model of record until 21 Oct 2026: a 70/30 mix of pan-European Dixon-Coles and Elo, from goals only.
Like the model of record, but domestic strengths learnt only from price-implied expected goals, in every league with prices rather than the top five.
Like the model of record (a quarter goals, three quarters price-implied expected goals), but in every league with prices rather than the top five.
The all-league, expected-goals-only variant with an 80/20 mix; it led on validation but not on the test (D-026).
Baseline: home, draw and away, goal-line and both-teams-to-score rates over UEFA matches in the last three years; the same forecast for every match.
